articles.title: War in Iran Hits Home: Modi Urges Indians to Skip Gold, Foreign Travel
articles.summary: A war thousands of miles away is squeezing India's wallet. PM Modi is calling for a year of sacrifice—no gold, no overseas vacations, and working from home—to protect the country's shrinking foreign exchange reserves.

articles.title: ‘Total Lack of Respect’: Macron Shushes Audience at Africa Summit
articles.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron halted a speaker mid-presentation at the Africa Forward summit in Nairobi to scold the crowd for side conversations, calling their behavior disrespectful and urging them to take chats outside.

articles.title: Starmer Fights for Survival, Pledges Closer EU Ties After Election Drubbing
articles.summary: Battered by catastrophic local election results, UK PM Keir Starmer is battling a leadership crisis. He vowed to prove doubters wrong by moving Britain closer to the EU, but dozens of his own MPs are urging him to set a departure date.
